name: readme-commands
title: The commands the READMEs tell a reader to run
description: A command a document names and the CLI does not know is a broken instruction, and the front door is where that costs most. Extract every dove-pi invocation from both READMEs, establish what the README is claiming - a list or an example, which a previous round learned to check first - and hold each name against the router
